independence: Each role was filled by separate fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions (subject x3, safety x2, language x2, lessons split by count), each given only its own role's work orders (openlessons jury orders) and told never to open another role's orders or verdicts; verdicts were written to per-role folders and combined only by jury run after all seven sessions had finished. The drafting model (claude-fable-5) sat on no role.

notes: subject: answer c (a stronger push makes the ball go faster) is correct, but the hint 'Apakah benda menjauh atau mendekat?' (away or toward?) is about the direction of the push, not its strength, so it does not help. Use a hint like 'Bayangkan menendang bola pelan, lalu keras.'.

claims.claim: A push or a pull can start, stop or change the motion of an object, and a stronger push changes its motion more (e.g. makes a ball go faster).

sources.title: NGSS K-PS2-1 Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
